name: Sanken Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Sanken Electric Co., Ltd. engages in the design, development, manufacturing, and sales of semiconductor and electronic application equipment products in Japan, Asia, China, Europe, South Korea, the United States, and internationally. It offers power management ICs and motor drivers; microcontroller, such as digital power management ICs; and discretes, including power MOSEFT, IGBT, bipolar transistors, diodes, and discrete modules. The company also provides LEDs, such as visible light LEDs, infrared, and automotive interior LEDs; power modules, including automotive intelligent power modules (IPMs), intelligent power modules (IPMs), automotive discrete modules, arrays.
